newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-RAIN INTERRUPTS PLAY AT WIMBLEDON AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RAIN INTERRUPTS PLAY AT WIMBLEDON AGAIN.

text.p: Rain stopped play at Wimbledon on Thursday, interrupting the Centre Court quarter-final between Pete Sampras and Boris Becker with the American 3-1 up in the first set.
On Court One another former champion Michael Stich of Germany had just won his first service game against home favourite Tim Henman.
Australian doubles specialist Todd Woodbridge was 7-6 2-6 6-0 3-4 up against another German 19-year-old Nicolas Kiefer on Court Two.
But the first women's semifinal beat the weather with top seed Martina Hingis of Switzerland defeating Russia's Anna Kournikova 6-3 6-2.
Cedric Pioline of France had also earlier beaten Briton Greg Rusedski 6-4 4-6 6-4 6-3 in their quarter-final on Court One.
This year's championships have been ravaged by rain with two days last week completely washed out and several others disrupted.
